scope: Read-only source review plus this evidence write. No GPU, application, benchmark, profiler, product or registry mutation. No build performed by reviewer.

findings.topic: Recheck frontier predicate under the lock used for intervention
findings.evidence: invocation.cc:552 takes no ready native job under an earlier lock; CPU child can publish progress before new lock at564. The current intervention must also require !changed() under that new lock, so error/cancel/done/new native readiness returns to original predicate path.
findings.requested: Use if (pending == 1 && !changed()) at the intervention. Fixed shape0/1 race occurrence is not asserted; this ensures the declared precondition rather than broadening diagnostic semantics.
findings.resolution: Final source rechecked at571: pending==1 && !changed() under pipeline_mutex. Kind52 records low32 pending count and high32 CPU-ready boolean under the same lock; it creates no owner, queue or synchronization rule. The earlier build remains historical and is not this final object certificate.

findings.evidence: include/hyle/compute/result.h:100 returns const Completion& stored in OwnedResult. Fragment pending and value.pending_transfer stay in RunState; current native root alone settles these handles. CPU lane updates frontier/CPU stages, and caller cannot rebind/reset during accepted work. Root retains RunState through drive and original cleanup. Unlocking pipeline_mutex does not free or replace the selected Completion.

findings.topic: Only already admitted unique native prefix; no lock held during wait
findings.evidence: Selection is run.pending_native[0] only at pending==1 after original ready admission loop. Fragment selects pending.completion(); upload/download select original pending_transfer. Existing valid check retains old fallback. pipeline_mutex unlock surrounds Completion.wait; src/compute_route_vulkan/vulkan_run.cc:251-269 releases runtime mutex for native WaitForFences. CPU child is spawned before drive_native_lane.

A failed wait only updates pipeline_error under lock, then original top-of-loop stops admissions; drive_graph waits CPU stopped and its existing fragment/transfer cleanup observes all accepted handles before terminal publication. No pending handle is dropped by intervention and original poll/finish/output/read/drain remain.

findings.topic: Negative controls and fixed measurement boundary
findings.evidence: facade.cc, wrapper.cc, recorder.h and API are normalized identical. Shape0/1 have independent CPU/native branches. Shape2/3 fixed dependent DAGs previously took !pipeline_parallel path, unchanged by new code. New diagnostic must show zero record kinds50/51 for shape2/3; old control images must also have zero50/51. All shapes retain original full oracles, slots,8warmups,12paired rounds/exact1 and drain. New kind52 is also intervention-only; fixed shape2/3 and old images must have zero50/51/52 records.

findings.topic: Diagnostic ready-guard bypass and arm mapping
findings.evidence: driver only adds explicit G09_NATIVE_WAIT_DIAGNOSTIC bypass to private ready guard; CMake candidate paths point at new wait facade, baseline paths at R25 observed original; original imported nanobench archive remains. No public perf source changes. Launcher must freeze DIAGNOSTIC=1, HYLE_BENCH_AA_ROUTE empty, verify_only false, no formal qualifier output. Otherwise candidate A/A route could choose two new images rather than the intended old/new comparison.

Independent actual build/link map/COFF review must prove replacement invocation TU and unchanged frozen SDK/leaf runtime; imported old invocation archive member must not be extracted.

Validate original4before+4after oracles,8State retirements,4M/slots,normal exit,record overflow,actual priority/mask/caller and OBS absence; stop on first failure.
Preserve all original failures; results are diagnostic, neither A/A/P1 qualification nor GPU-ready timestamp.
interpretation_limits: Completion.wait return is host-observed successful native prefix retirement upper bound, including driver/scheduling/bookkeeping; not exact GPU kernel end.
This scratch blocking intervention is restricted to the frozen single-independent-native-branch fixture, not a general DAG wait algorithm.
Differences can establish observation-strategy contribution under this fixture but cannot alone identify all original A/A bias or be promoted to shipping product fix.

The original frontier uses sched::ConditionVariable, a fiber-aware timed wait; direct Completion.wait blocks its worker. Any effect is observation/wakeup strategy contribution, not isolated pure1ms device notification latency. Another worker remains available for the fixed CPU lane.
recheck: Final guarded predicate and kind52 independently re-read; source-only pass. Parent reported an earlier build but no application/GPU run; reviewer did not validate final binary identity.
